dialogues.speaker: Lixing
dialogues.text: Take this for example. Agency A must transport goods from Lumidouce Harbor to Liyue Harbor.

dialogues.speaker: Lixing
dialogues.text: During this process, they transport the goods to the docks between Qiaoying Village and Qingce Village...

dialogues.speaker: Lixing
dialogues.text: They can choose to transport the goods and carts to the opposite shore and continue on land.

dialogues.speaker: Lixing
dialogues.text: Now, you may have realized that continuing south along the waterway before getting on land at Wangshu Inn is the superior option!

dialogues.speaker: Lixing
dialogues.text: But things aren't that simple. The ship traveling down the waterway may not belong to Agency A. It may belong to the Communications Office, Agency B, or independent shipowner C.

dialogues.speaker: Lixing
dialogues.text: In moments like these, specialized personnel are required to coordinate the transfers between different individuals or organizations. That is the transportation plan I mentioned.
